title: How Your Microwave Really Heats Food

scenes.text: What invisible wave cooks your popcorn in seconds?
scenes.query2: microwave oven how it heats food

scenes.label: MAGNETRON EMITS 2.45 GHz
scenes.text: The magnetron generates microwaves at 2.45 GHz, a frequency absorbed by water molecules.

scenes.label: MOLECULE VIBRATION HEATS
scenes.text: Absorbed energy makes water molecules vibrate, producing heat that spreads through the food.

scenes.label: TURNTABLE ENSURES EVEN HEAT
scenes.text: A rotating turntable moves food through standing wave patterns for uniform heating.
